source.title: Some recent results and open problems concerning special radicals

trace.notes: Normalized the single URL input as the zbMATH resolver record https://zbmath.org/4183614. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv and outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identifies the exact work as Barry J. Gardner, "Some recent results and open problems concerning special radicals", 1989, with no DOI, arXiv identifier, or full-text link recorded.

failure_mode=metadata_only. Direct shell fetching of zbMATH and the zbMATH REST API failed because DNS/network access is disabled in the local sandbox. Browser access to the zbMATH author profile confirmed the title and Zbl 0718.16013, but did not expose the article body or problem statements. Bounded exact-work searches for the title, title plus PDF, Zbl number, and the Radical Theory 1988 Sendai proceedings found only citations, library metadata, and later related papers, not a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source. Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/4183614.json and outputs/latest.json.
